head: codex/505-v3-f-authority-transition-decision-exec
title: [v0.92.1][V3-F] C-SDLC v3 authority-transition decision
body:
Part of #505

Prepares the V3-F authority-transition decision surface. This PR does not approve cutover: C-SDLC v2 remains the live lifecycle authority until #505 receives explicit operator approval, merge, typed finish, and cleanup reconciliation.

Current reconciliation:
- Merged current `main` into PR #591 and resolved the v3 command-route conflicts.
- Replaced stale V3-H evidence with current live readback showing umbrella #625 and child issues #627-#632 closed.
- Retains one visible `csdlc` binary surface with 25 visible v3 commands and 21 implemented v2 replacement routes, while `cutover_ready=false` remains explicit.
- Records evidence-backed #179/#180 dispositions in `docs/csdlc-v3/authority-transition-disposition.json`.
- Reconciles `docs/csdlc-v3/CUTOVER_READINESS_NOTICE.md` so V3-H completion and deferred authority are both true.
- Adds proof-route scratch cleanup so the v3 proof/install/shadow/soak tests do not leave repo-local `.csdlc/evidence/631/proof-route-tests/` residue.
- Refreshes exact-head review truth after the current-main merge and publication request cleanup.

Validation at the reconciled head:
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets` — PASS, 129 tests.
- `cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings` — PASS.
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all --check` — PASS.
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/505/validate-authority-transition-prep.rb` — PASS.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — PASS.
- `.adl/bin/csdlc-v2/csdlc-validate --root . issue --issue 505` — PASS, `ready=false` as expected before cutover.

Review:
- Independent bounded review after current-main reconciliation: PASS at substantive revision `4bc63d390e421702607837b2e4193d0e5573321f`, with later metadata-only/request-only commits not changing the implementation or authority surfaces reviewed for the main cutover-defer findings.
- Follow-up narrow publication-linkage review: PASS at exact revision `f5621b164ef62c18885b5b57c4eff58a901fbbb2` for the typed-publication-compatible `Part of #505` wording, corrected proof count, and non-closing guard.

Remaining approval blockers:
- Actual rollback-exercise evidence is still required before operator approval.
- Terminal v3 finish/cleanup canary evidence is still required, unless the operator records an explicit bounded waiver.
- Operator approval is absent.

Non-claims:
- This PR does not make v3 live authority, retire v2, mark issue 505 complete, merge or finish issue 505, clean worktrees, or bypass operator approval.
- This PR intentionally uses `Part of #505`, not a GitHub closing keyword.
